articles.title: Federated Hermes joins Wall Street's tokenization push with plans for first onchain fund shares
articles.snippet: The $911 billion Pittsburgh-based asset manager is teaming up with Prometheum to bring blockchain-based share classes of its funds to traditional brokerage accounts.

articles.title: UK court ruling boosts government’s chances of keeping $5 billion in seized bitcoin
articles.snippet: The decision concerns 61,000 BTC seized by the Metropolitan Police in its investigation into Zhimin Qian, who pleaded guilty to defrauding thousands of people in China.

articles.title: Metaplanet to issue $329M convertible bonds to pay debt, fund share buybacks
articles.snippet: Metaplanet plans to issue zero-interest bonds with a five-year maturity to improve its debt structure and cut its reliance on Bitcoin-collateralized loans without selling holdings.

articles.title: Meta claims new Muse Wonder AI models rival OpenAI, Anthropic
articles.snippet: Meta co-founder Mark Zuckerberg said its newest models are a step toward “personal superintelligence.”

articles.title: Meta's New Muse Wonder Finally Puts Zuckerberg in the Frontier AI Race
articles.snippet: Meta's new flagship beats GPT-6 Astra and Claude on memory, legal and marathon coding tests, but independent rankings still put Anthropic's Opus 5.5 on top.
